'''Cartao''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Prackla sector/Legends|Prackla sector]]. The [[siviviv vine]] was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Cartao, and it was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Cranscoc]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic War]], upstart [[Crime lord/Legends|crime bosses]] like [[Mal Khestekk]] tried to become important figures in the underworld of Cartao.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|The New Boss}}</ref>

Cartao was the source of [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]]s. The world reluctantly remained loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Attack on Cartao|Battle of Cartao]] was fought in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Wikipedia: Portuguese language|Portuguese]] language, "cartao" (more properly cartão) is the word for "card" (as in "[[Wikipedia:Credit card|credit card]]").
